acceptance.trainingExport: Existing trainer exports the minimum unweighted natural validation choiceNll checkpoint; this is not deployment approval.
acceptance.finalSelection: Retain all eight epochs. Apply the separately frozen expanded-validation single-action guards versus same-data v1/parent; filter jointly feasible checkpoints before choosing minimum natural validation NLL, exact ties earlier. No feasible checkpoint means no deployment candidate.
acceptance.legacyPolicy: The pilot decision includes the unchanged 21 legacy guards and 2 riichi improvements. Causal 13-check screening controls only whether 3p auxiliary loss is enabled. It does not replace or relax final acceptance.
acceptance.confirmationBoundary: Expanded validation includes previously examined old validation games. Report old/new and pre/post daiminkan strata; no fresh-holdout claim.

convergence.naturalComparison: Compare unweighted fixed 4096-game trainMonitor with full validation at the same checkpoint. Weighted online trainLoss is not comparable to natural validation NLL.
convergence.localPlateauDescription: At the final budget, two consecutive absolute validation NLL changes below 0.001 plus riichi type/full recall swings at most 0.003 are necessary descriptive criteria. Kan convergence additionally requires at least 100 positive validation/monitor opportunities and stable TP/FP; lack of support is inconclusive.
convergence.monitorScope: Hash-selected from all actual training IDs, including appended data; it is fitted training data, not an independent held-out sample.
convergence.numericalScope: Use existing trainer finite-loss and export-parity checks unchanged. Detailed equal-logit/ranking and single-action acceptance are performed by the separate frozen evaluator; this wrapper does not add a training algorithm or claim global convergence.

frozenTrainingPlan.changeScope: Expanded full train corpus, safe daiminkan suffix extraction, natural training monitor, and separately frozen action checkpoint acceptance. The boundary auxiliary loss failed its frozen causal screen and is disabled in both modes.
frozenTrainingPlan.processWrapper: caffeinate -i while the authorized training process is running
